newsitem.title: UK: Albert Fisher to confirm seafood sale-paper.
newsitem.headline: Albert Fisher to confirm seafood sale-paper.

text.p: British food processing and distribution company Albert Fisher Group Plc is expected to confirm the sale of its seafood division by Wednesday for up to 100 million pounds ($161.1 million), the Financial Times said on Monday.
Fisher announced last week it had terminated talks to sell the company. The firm did not reveal the identity of the bidder, but market rumours centred on American banana supplier Chiquita Brands.
Instead, Fisher said, the group would split itself up and offer parts of the business for sale, possibly enabling it to buy back some of its own shares.
The group said it would put proposals for a share buyback to shareholders as soon as possible.

Fisher is divided into four divisions -- European fresh produce which includes Saphir Fruit, European food processing, the Seafood unit in Britain and Holland which includes MacFish and Forman Fish based in Scotland, and a fresh fruit and vegetables business in North America called River Ranch.
